name: Sculpfun S30 Ultra 11W
tagline: Entry S30 Ultra frame: engraving-first, light cutting
tldr: The S30 Ultra 11W (Sculpfun's entry head, sometimes listed as 10W) uses the same rigid frame as higher-power models but targets makers who mainly engrave wood, leather, and slate. Expect slower cuts and thinner material limits than the 22W or 33W versions.

priceRange.note: Official Sculpfun store, Oct 2026: $399.99 for the machine (EU stock, US stock sold out), $489.99 with LightBurn (sold out)

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Same frame, adapter and cable as the stronger heads: upgrading means swapping only the laser head
Fine ~0.07 mm spot in our profile for detailed photo and text work
Lowest-priced way into the S30 Ultra frame and its linear-rail X axis
cons: Photo fills of ~18–37 mm/s: a 10 × 10 cm photo takes ~11–18 min
Cutting 5 mm stock takes several passes at 2–4 mm/s
Adding a stronger head later costs more than starting with a stronger kit
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 11W head on the Sculpfun S30 Ultra. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

editorialDepth.advantages: Sculpfun S30 Ultra 11W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 5 mm+ cutting in production: see the 22W or 33W heads. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.

faq.question: Is this the S30 Ultra 10W some listings mention?
faq.answer: Sculpfun sells the entry S30 Ultra as an 11W head, and this profile covers that entry module. It shares the frame, power adapter and laser cable with the 22W and 33W heads, so upgrading later means swapping only the head. In October 2026 Sculpfun sold the 22W and 33W heads as upgrade kits at $389.99 and $549.99.

faq.question: What does the entry S30 Ultra cut in one pass?
faq.answer: In our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 7–11 min at 2–4 mm/s. 5 mm basswood needs two or more passes with air assist, and clear acrylic cannot be cut. It is an engraving-first configuration.

faq.question: Should I start with this head or go straight to the 22W?
faq.answer: Start here if you mostly engrave and want the lowest entry ($399.99 on Sculpfun's store in October 2026 against $539.99–569.99 for the 22W machine). If you already know you will cut 5 mm or more every week, buying the stronger kit up front costs less than adding a $399.99 head later.

standoutFeatures.title: Upgradeable head
standoutFeatures.body: Sculpfun designed the S30 Ultra so the 11W, 22W and 33W heads share the adapter, structure and cable: only the head changes.

standoutFeatures.title: Fine spot for engraving
standoutFeatures.body: About 0.07 mm in our benchmark profile, the finest of the S30 Ultra heads we list.

standoutFeatures.title: Linear rail on the X axis
standoutFeatures.body: Sculpfun fits a linear slide rail on the X axis, which helps keep small engraved details free of wobble.
